name: kingscliff-maths-booklets
description: Builds printable Year 7 maths lesson booklets (PDF) themed with artwork by Marni Tuala.

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.build:all: for d in year7/ch*/; do node build.js $d; done
scripts.build:blend: for d in year7-blend/ch*/; do node build.js $d; done
